game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Royal Stables, the royal stables: the royal scribe must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Print Probe: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before goblin raiders act.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Stables: the royal stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Stables, repeat each round: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before goblin raiders act. Each round, goblin raiders strike the royal seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the shield value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the royal seal from goblin raiders in Royal Stables: keep the shield meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: shield drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Print Probe
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Probe' (Week 1 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Royal Stables'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how shield changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Royal Stables.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while shield > 0.
